title.zh: Phantom launches Kalshi-powered prediction markets for US users
title.en: Phantom launches Kalshi-powered prediction markets for US users

current_state.zh: Phantom launched CFTC-regulated prediction markets for eligible US users through a Kalshi integration, allowing in-app trading on crypto prices, sports, and other events funded via Phantom Cash.
